content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to figure out why, when using [product_name], inserting timetable variables shows a '16#' prefix before the values. The correct values appear and can be changed, but it's not clear why '16#' is displayed. Thanks.

You've posted this topic in the German section of the forum. Moderation will move your question to the international section. How can I remove the hex prefix (16#) when displaying switch times for a weekly timer in the extended web server?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is confused about seeing hexadecimal '16#' prefixes next to timetable variables in [product_name]. This creates uncertainty in understanding timer data, which impacts ease of use and clarity when working with weekly timers.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects timetable variables to be shown in a clear, decimal format, avoiding hexadecimal prefixes, to make timer configuration and viewing more straightforward.
